delivery_scope: D only. C/Q/X/I have not been delivered or frozen; cross-subset original-ID/content deduplication remains pending.
experiment_status: Historical experiment only; no new model run performed by this builder.

source_pool.normalization: NFKC, casefold, collapse Unicode whitespace; material contents deduplicated and sorted. Controlled only: remove '# Controlled research case research-*' identifier heading, replace Trial-N and Evaluation record N counters. Real numbers and public document titles retained. Gold, scores and outputs excluded.
source_pool.same_family_correlation: Controlled instances are parameter variants within ten families; content dedup does not make them independent research tasks.

sampling.stratification: ten controlled families + scifact + qasper (12 strata)
sampling.allocation: Hamilton proportional allocation; exact integer remainders; equal remainders broken by Random(seed).shuffle(sorted(strata)).
sampling.within_stratum_sampling: Independent Random(seed); iterate sorted strata, sample sorted task IDs; final output sorted by ID.

gold_conversion: Public kind/gold retained. Controlled claim becomes native claim with INSUFFICIENT mapped to NOT ENOUGH EVIDENCE; other controlled cases become qa with generated short reference variants derived only from existing gold. Original gold and structured criteria retained separately, not applied as native scores.
